description: Delete training sessions from the calendar for good: one or several by session_ids, or every planned session between start_date and end_date. One session is deleted at once. Several ids or a date range are a preview first: dry_run defaults to true and the result lists what would go; the same call with dry_run: false deletes them, 100 at most. A date range leaves completed sessions alone unless include_done is true. Where the user has Google Calendar connected, the events go too. Races on the user's list are not touched; remove_race does those. All dates are the user's local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in their own time zone. Requires signing in.

dry_run.description: True lists what would be deleted and deletes nothing. Default true for several ids or a date range, false for one id.

end_date.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Leave out for start_date alone.

include_done.description: With a date range: true also deletes completed sessions. Default false.

session_ids.description: ids of the sessions to delete, from get_calendar, get_training_log or add_sessions.

start_date.description: First day of a range to clear, YYYY-MM-DD. Instead of session_ids.

name: remove_sessions
title: Delete sessions
